sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The lactose of the whey is turned into alcohol by yeast.

steps.name: distil
steps.note: The vodka is distilled to about 48 % alcohol by volume, then cut down to 40 %.
The vodka is filtered three times, once through coconut-husk carbon.
